build_radius_graph_preprocess: build a module that preprocesses AtomicData into GraphAttentionData using biknn radius graph construction and edge expansion
create_frequency_vectors: create frequency vectors from edge direction tensors using spherical harmonics and a configurable frequency list
compute_node_direction_expansion: compute bond-orientational order features for each node using spherical harmonics and neighbor masking
generate_node_attention_mask: generate node-level attention masks with sincx Euclidean rotary encoding and pairwise distance filtering
pad_and_unpad_batch: pad a batch of molecular graphs to fixed size for torch.compile and unpad results after model inference
